Today, we freeze our buns off as we check out one of the best winter jacket brands on the planet: Fjällräven. Specifically, we're looking at their Expedition Parka and their Polar Expedition Parka. One utilizes their G1000 waxed canvas (or, waxable canvas), and the other does not. They are both some of the warmest winter down jackets on the market and are absolute tanks. I know this because they are hanging up next to me right now.

Fjällräven, if you don't know, is the brand behind the ever-famous Kånken backpack (bright, small backpack). 

Next week, we continue our hunt for the greatest winter jackets of all time. Diving into Eddie Bauer, North Face, Mountain Hardware, and the like. It’s time to party! 

Tah-tah!
